summary: Consume the iterable protocol, ToPropertyKey each entry key, and create own data properties.

semantics.input: must be iterable; null/undefined and non-iterables throw
semantics.entry: each yielded item must be Object-like entry with indices 0 and 1
semantics.definition: CreateDataPropertyOrThrow on a new ordinary object
semantics.abrupt_completion: IteratorClose is required when entry processing throws

caveats: Dictionary construction does not implement arbitrary JavaScript iterables or IteratorClose.
The key '__proto__' becomes a normal own data property; it must not mutate the prototype.
